visibleTestCases.title: Put and Get via Registered Name
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin catch named_kv_actor:stop(), {ok, _} = named_kv_actor:start_registered(), ok = named_kv_actor:put(<<"session_token">>, <<"active_123">>), Res = named_kv_actor:get(<<"session_token">>), named_kv_actor:stop(), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Performs put and get operations using make_ref() correlation against registered named actor.

visibleTestCases.title: Lookup Missing Key
